notes.title: New Lower Price!
notes.content:
We've dropped the price of Littlewitch Romanesque in celebration of the release of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/691770/EiyuSenki_The_World_Conquest/][i]Eiyu*Senki – The World Conquest[/i][/url] onto Steam!

Both games come from the creative and artistic talents of Oyari Ashito, who was the director and character designer for both games. While their stories take place in very different worlds, the aesthetic and character development in both are equally top-tier thanks to his dedication to his craft. We're very excited to have another one of this titles here on Steam!

notes.title: Now On Steam!
notes.content:
It's been a big first day for us, and since Littlewitch Romanesque is our first title to be published on Steam we weren't sure what to expect. But since the game's release, fans have been sending us [i]overwhelmingly[/i] positive messages about their love of Littlewitch Romanesque and its story, art and characters. Thank you! Moments like today remind us why we love what we do – releasing amazing Japanese games for the world.

Thanks again to everyone for the warm welcome to Steam and your ongoing support!

notes.title: Just 24 Hours Until Release!
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support with getting Littlewitch Romanesque onto Steam. We couldn't have done it without you! 

You'll be happy to know the game is arriving with Steam Cards (with amazing profile backgrounds as rewards), plus Steam Cloud save support so you can continue playing your game from anywhere. 

We've also worked hard to include the three bonus stories, originally released as a separate add-on purchase, as part of our release. No additional DLC needed! These will be unlocked upon successful completion of the game so you can experience the backstories of Domino and his companions. 

Littlewitch Romanesque releases tomorrow, April 3rd, and to celebrate we're having a special 10% off sale for all our fans who've been patiently waiting for its release!
